title: Maximize Non-Adjacent Value
prerequisite: Baseline decomposition and comfort with array iteration.
hints: At each value, compare two possibilities: skip it and keep the previous best, or take it plus the best from before its neighbor.
Only the previous two prefix totals are needed, so the dynamic-programming state can use two scalar variables.
Update current = max(previous, value + twoBack), then shift the two saved totals forward. Starting at zero permits selecting nothing.
